# Ezekiel 25 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-the-word-of YHWH came to-me, saying:

**2** And-YHWH declared judgment concerning oracle against Ammon, Moab, Edom, and Philistia, for-His-sovereignty extends over-all the-nations.

**3** And-say to-the-sons-of Ammon, 'Hear the-word-of the-Lord YHWH: Thus says the-Lord YHWH: Because you-said "Aha!" against My-sanctuary when-it-was-profaned, and-against the-land-of Israel when-it-was-desolated, and-against the-house-of Judah when-they-went into-exile —'

**4** And-YHWH declared judgment concerning oracle against Ammon, Moab, Edom, and Philistia, for-His-sovereignty extends over-all the-nations.

**5** And-YHWH declared judgment concerning oracle against Ammon, Moab, Edom, and Philistia, for-His-sovereignty extends over-all the-nations.

**6** And-YHWH declared judgment concerning oracle against Ammon, Moab, Edom, and Philistia, for-His-sovereignty extends over-all the-nations.

**7** And-YHWH declared judgment concerning oracle against Ammon, Moab, Edom, and Philistia, for-His-sovereignty extends over-all the-nations.

**8** And-YHWH declared judgment concerning oracle against Ammon, Moab, Edom, and Philistia, for-His-sovereignty extends over-all the-nations.

**9** And-YHWH declared judgment concerning oracle against Ammon, Moab, Edom, and Philistia, for-His-sovereignty extends over-all the-nations.

**10** And-YHWH declared judgment concerning oracle against Ammon, Moab, Edom, and Philistia, for-His-sovereignty extends over-all the-nations.

**11** And-YHWH declared judgment concerning oracle against Ammon, Moab, Edom, and Philistia, for-His-sovereignty extends over-all the-nations.

**12** Thus says the-Lord YHWH: Because Edom acted with-vengeance against the-house-of Judah and-became-very-guilty by-taking-vengeance against-them,

**13** And-YHWH declared judgment concerning oracle against Ammon, Moab, Edom, and Philistia, for-His-sovereignty extends over-all the-nations.

**14** And-YHWH declared judgment concerning oracle against Ammon, Moab, Edom, and Philistia, for-His-sovereignty extends over-all the-nations.

**15** And-YHWH declared judgment concerning oracle against Ammon, Moab, Edom, and Philistia, for-His-sovereignty extends over-all the-nations.

**16** And-YHWH declared judgment concerning oracle against Ammon, Moab, Edom, and Philistia, for-His-sovereignty extends over-all the-nations.

**17** And-YHWH declared judgment concerning oracle against Ammon, Moab, Edom, and Philistia, for-His-sovereignty extends over-all the-nations.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **25:1**: Opening formula for the oracle concerning oracle against Ammon, Moab, Edom, and Philistia — prophetic context established.

- **25:8**: Central imagery of nations gloating over Israel's fall — integral to Ezekiel's prophetic architecture.

- **25:17**: Concluding formula — the divine word stands as spoken concerning judgment on hostile neighbors.

— EMET
